initialize_train_config: initialize a TrainConfig with a config object to set up models, datasets, and data loaders for training
inference_forward_pass: run inference on a batch through all models to get postprocessed outputs and inference dictionaries
save_model_weights: save model weights and optimizer state to the log directory with a given name suffix
load_latest_weights: load the latest saved model weights and optimizer state from the log directory to resume training
weights_locked_check: check whether model weights are locked for a given epoch and network index based on config rules
